caption: The drawing depicts two elongated metal objects, both colored in shades of gray and blue with some darker and reddish brown areas on the lower object, giving them a weathered or aged appearance. Each object is flat and has a pointed, diamond-shaped end on the right, with a circular hole near this end and additional smaller holes spaced along their length. On the left side, both objects feature a hollow, cylindrical loop, while the lower object also has a flat, bent arm extending downward at a right angle from the loop. The objects are placed horizontally and parallel to each other against a plain off-white background within a lightly drawn rectangular border. The surface of the paper shows slight discoloration in places, especially toward the edges.
title: Hasps
